model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates negative log probability values across several medical specialties for different model configurations. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms with categories labeled Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” displays a linear scale ranging from approximately -22 to -27, with tick marks at intervals of 1.  Six sets of bars are present, one for each model configuration: Mistralv0.2-Base (light blue), Fine-tuned on: Cardio (orange), Gastro (orange), Infect (orange), Neuro (orange), Obstetrics (orange), and Pediatrics (orange). Within each specialty, the bars represent the negative log probability for each model; for example, in the Cardio specialty, the Mistralv0.2-Base model has an approximate negative log probability of -23.5, while the Fine-tuned on Cardio model has a negative log probability of approximately -22.2. The bars are grouped by specialty, with each model configuration displayed side-by-side. The shortest bar is associated with the Pediatrics specialty and the Fine-tuned on: Pediatrics model, with a value of approximately -23.8, and the tallest bar is associated with the Cardio specialty and the Mistralv0.2-Base model, with a value of approximately -23.5. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
